title: Planning-Aligned Pretraining of BEV Representations with Sparse Action-Conditioned Targets for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2609.22868v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: End-to-end driving requires planning-relevant bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations, but existing pretraining approaches often rely on task annotations or dense scene reconstruction. We introduce PAVER, Planning-Aligned BEV Encoder Pretraining. From a single LiDAR sweep, PAVER constructs sparse risk and unknown targets describing occupied and unobserved evidence along rule-based ego motions. A 10K-parameter head predicts these targets from masked BEV features conditioned on the action state, directing supervision toward geometric constraints on candidate motions. Pretraining requires no driving-task annotations or dense reconstruction. Only the BEV encoder is transferred, preserving the downstream architecture and camera-only inference. On nuScenes, PAVER reduces VAD-Tiny's average collision rate from 0.51% to 0.19%, while improving planning L2, motion prediction, detection, and mapping. translated_title: 面向端到端自动驾驶的基于稀疏动作条件目标的规划对齐BEV表征预训练
translated_abstract: 端到端驾驶需要与规划相关的鸟瞰图（BEV）表征，但现有的预训练方法通常依赖任务标注或密集场景重建。我们提出了PAVER（Planning-Aligned BEV Encoder Pretraining，规划对齐的BEV编码器预训练）。PAVER从单次LiDAR扫描中构建稀疏的风险与未知目标，用于描述沿基于规则的自车运动过程中的占据和未观测证据。一个仅含1万参数的预测头从以动作状态为条件的掩码BEV特征中预测这些目标，从而将监督引导至候选运动的几何约束上。该预训练无需任何驾驶任务标注或密集重建。仅迁移BEV编码器，从而保持下游架构和纯相机推理不变。在nuScenes数据集上，PAVER将VAD-Tiny的平均碰撞率从0.51%降低至0.19%，同时改进了规划L2误差、运动预测、目标检测和在线建图。所选的VAD-Tiny和VAD-Base训练计划使用……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PAVER提出了一种无需驾驶任务标注的BEV预训练方法，通过从单帧LiDAR构建稀疏的动作条件风险目标将表征与规划对齐，使VAD-Tiny的平均碰撞率从0.51%降至0.19%。
en_tdlr: PAVER introduces an annotation-free BEV pretraining approach that aligns representations with planning by constructing sparse action-conditioned risk targets from a single LiDAR sweep, reducing VAD-Tiny's average collision rate from 0.51% to 0.19%.
